newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom cuts rates for its Telenotes paper.
newsitem.headline: Telecom cuts rates for its Telenotes paper.

text.p: Telecom New Zealand Limited on Friday cut the rate on its interest bearing TeleNotes being issued under a debt programme started in April.

For an initial term of five years, the company is now offering investors 7.25 percent, down from 7.50 percent, and for a nine-year term the rate is 7.50 percent, down from a previous 7.75 percent at the last change on June 6.
The other terms and conditions remain as set by an earlier prospectus, the company said in a statement. The notes will be offered under the current prospectus until June 30.
